title: Duality
identity: Catherine McMichael, Duality (2018), for tenor saxophone and piano. A 2018 congress program documents the three movements, the premiere of Circularity, and Scott Sandberg’s commission for tenor-saxophone repertoire. A 2020 recording by Sandberg and Keith Teepen is catalogued at Albany Records.

evidence.claim: Composer work catalog identifies the three-movement tenor saxophone work, advanced descriptor and 11-minute duration.
The 2020 Albany Records release includes the piece with Scott Sandberg, tenor saxophone, and Keith Teepen, piano.
Composer’s Zagreb saxophone congress program note states Scott Sandberg commissioned it to expand tenor saxophone repertoire.

A 2018 Zagreb Saxophone Congress program names Duality for tenor saxophone and piano, its three movements (Polarity, Linearity, Circularity), identifies Circularity as a premiere, and quotes Scott Sandberg saying he commissioned a ten-minute work to build tenor repertoire.
Albany Records catalogue search identifies a recording of Duality by Scott Sandberg, tenor saxophone, and Keith Teepen, piano, released in 2020.
Apple Music Classical lists the recorded three tracks and a combined duration of 11:07.

review_focus: Inference: the premiere program and recording establish professional repertoire use, not a level. Compare the three contrasting movements and review exact notation; no score was accessible.
collection_flag: Original commissioned tenor saxophone/piano work with a documented premiere and professional recording.

listening.description: Albany Records TROY1807 lists Scott Sandberg and Keith Teepen; record page search result identifies track Duality.
listening.verification: Catalog listing located; playback not auditioned.
